title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff and regional failover (load-shedding loop)
author: Lina Chen
description:
Context: After the incident on 2026-02-18 we observed a cascading load-shedding loop in the SLO enforcer when regional failover and backoff hysteresis overlapped. The enforcer would aggressively mark regional pools as degraded, trigger failover, then immediately re-inject traffic which retripped the backoff. This caused repeated failovers and elevated error budgets for a subset of customers.

This PR: fixes two related issues in the SLO enforcer: 1) backoff timer reset on transient success windows (causing premature reattachment), and 2) a race between region-degraded state transitions and the load-shedding decision path that caused oscillation. The change introduces a small hysteresis window for re-qualification, preserves the existing exponential backoff policy, and adds a gate to prevent immediate re-scheduling into a recently-failed region.

Summary of changes: (see commits and changed files for details) - Add requalification_hysteresis_ms to region state machine with sane default (30s). - Prevent reattachment for regions with active backoff timers until backoff expires plus hysteresis. - Tighten metrics and logging for state transitions to make postmortem and alerting clearer. - Add an e2e load-shedding regression test that reproduces the failure pattern and asserts stability.

Testing & rollout: unit tests added and coverage updated; e2e sim test included. Ran canary for 4 hours in us-west-2 with no observed oscillations under a replay of the incident traffic. Config default keeps previous behavior for customers that manage their own thresholds; infra rollout includes a 10% canary then 100% over 2 hours.

Checklist: 
- [x] Reproduced failure locally with recorded trace
- [x] Unit tests updated and passing
- [x] e2e regression test added
- [x] Canaried in us-west-2, monitored SLOs/alerts
- [x] Updated ops runbook and release notes

Notes: This is a hotfix branch targeting immediate stabilization; follow-up work tracked in ENG-2145 will refactor the state machine for clearer invariants and add metric-driven automation to tune hysteresis per-tenant.
